title: 启用对比学习 Latent 一致性

standard.summary: 对比学习风格的一致性损失：同一 clean latent
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: A contrastive-learning style consistency loss: the same clean latent
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 对比学习风格的一致性损失：同一 clean latent 在不同噪声下的 x0 预测应该接近。简化模式 (noise_pairs=1) 无额外前向传播。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Contrastive-learning-style consistency loss: the x0 prediction for the same clean latent under different noise levels should stay close. Simplified mode (noise_pairs=1) adds no extra forward passes. Off by default.
